validation_results.expected_condition: no conclusion / verdict / recommendation field names

validation_results.what_tested: no emitted output field is a market-capture dial or output (demand is assumed, not modeled; the comparison is cost-vs-ground)
no emitted output field names the forbidden heavier-than-Neutron vehicle (Rocket Lab has only Neutron; the heavier vehicle is Phase-6 conclusion prose only)
the steady-state customer / cost / priced-cost outputs are low/mid/high bands with three populated numeric member cells (no scalar customer output)
validation_results.expected_condition: all three band-blocks have populated low/mid/high cells

validation_results.what_tested: the spectrum-to-acquire cell is a MHz requirement and no per-satellite cost line is a spectrum dollar figure (spectrum nets out of the cost comparison)
validation_results.expected_condition: spectrum unit == 'MHz' and no MHz cost line
validation_results.observed_result: spectrum unit='MHz'; no MHz cost line

validation_results.what_tested: per-beam capacity is driven by the empirical AST anchor and the naive bandwidth-times-efficiency figure is a labeled cross-check (never the capacity driver)
validation_results.expected_condition: capacity formula contains 'empirical_anchor' and naive formula contains 'naive_capacity_cross_check'

validation_results.what_tested: every ProvenanceCell formula_name exists in the FORMULAS registry (no silent formula-name typos)
validation_results.expected_condition: all formula_name values present in FORMULAS
validation_results.observed_result: all 572 cells reference one of 25 formula names, every one present in FORMULAS

validation_results.what_tested: the per-class packing fork is explicit: broadband is mass-bound, direct-to-cell is antenna-stow-bound, and broadband packs more satellites per launch
the steady-state served band is ascending and the per-satellite band lands near the default 50k/150k/300k target (a default-scenario calibration check, WARNs off-default)
the per-customer cost band is ascending and inverse-paired with the served band (cost-low pairs with served-high; cost x served reconciles to the fleet annual cost)
validation_results.expected_condition: ascending cost band and cost.low*served.high == cost.high*served.low

validation_results.what_tested: per-year launches are whole-number and non-decreasing up to the steady-state year (the cadence ramp is a logistic, never sign-flipped or fractional)
validation_results.expected_condition: integer, non-decreasing launches to the steady-state year

validation_results.what_tested: the steady-state direct-to-cell living fleet is larger than one year's deployment (the cohort treadmill: multiple living cohorts under the service-life cliff)
the source-status summary has no placeholder or stale default inputs (a promoted artifact must not present an unsettled input as settled)
validation_results.remediation_hint: Review model inputs, formulas, and source status.

validation_results.what_tested: meta.data_dictionary has >= 30 entries (the artifact is self-describing)
